title: A true professional

title: Options and creative solutions
quote:
I’ve worked with Daria on several projects (Instagram reels for a coffee shop, collage animations and a travel blog) and thoroughly enjoyed it!
What I love is that Daria doesn’t just follow instructions, she also suggests options and creative solutions, and she’s always up for brainstorming and talking ideas through. What I especially appreciate is that she offers solutions without pushing her own version and always keeps the client’s needs in focus. On top of doing great work and always being on time with deadlines, she’s simply easy and pleasant to communicate and work with. I sincerely recommend her!
